games.badge: The One That Started It All
games.blurb: The multiplayer flight sim that kicked off the vibe-coding craze — built in about three hours by a guy who had never made a game.
games.description: Pieter Levels asked Cursor to 'make a 3D flying game in the browser' in February 2025 and had a playable flight sim the same day. It grew into a shared multiplayer sky with dogfights,sponsor blimps and premium planes,and showed the world what one person plus AI could ship. Type a name,take off,and fly with whoever else is up there.
games.title: Flight Simulator 2025

games.blurb: The definitive tactical FPS,running in a browser tab. Bomb defusal,Dust2 and all.
games.description: CSJS brings Counter-Strike 1.6 to the browser with online matches against real players. Terrorists vs Counter-Terrorists in the format that defined a generation of shooters — no install,just open and play.
games.title: Counter-Strike 1.6

games.blurb: Ride the ramps. Classic Counter-Strike surf maps,rebuilt for the browser.
games.description: Surfd recreates the beloved surf game mode from Counter-Strike: glide along angled ramps,build speed and thread impossible lines through classic-style surf maps — right in your browser.
games.title: CS Surf

games.blurb: Gordon Freeman's worst day at work,playable in your browser.
games.description: Valve's 1998 masterpiece — the Black Mesa incident,the crowbar,the resonance cascade — running in a browser tab via a community web port of the Xash3D engine. One of the most influential shooters ever made,one click away.
games.title: Half-Life

games.blurb: Combat,evolved — in a browser tab. A fan-built web build of the Xbox classic.
games.description: Mitchell Hynes' Combat Lab brings Halo: Combat Evolved to the web: the ringworld,the Warthog,and the pistol that could snipe across the map. A loving fan port of Bungie's 2001 landmark shooter.
games.title: Halo: Combat Evolved

games.blurb: Halo: Combat Evolved tuned for phone browsers — touch controls and all.
games.description: HCEMobile takes the Halo CE browser experience and rebuilds it for mobile: play the classic on your phone's browser with touch controls,no app install required.
games.title: Halo CE Mobile

games.blurb: A Modern Warfare 2-style multiplayer shooter rebuilt to run in the browser.
games.description: Open Victor Zulu is an ambitious fan project recreating the Modern Warfare 2 multiplayer experience as a web game — fast infantry combat,familiar-feeling maps and gunplay,no install.
games.title: Modern Warfare 2 (Open Victor Zulu)

games.blurb: id Software's gothic FPS landmark — QuakeWorld multiplayer in your browser.
games.description: The original Quake (1996): rocket jumps,Shamblers,and the multiplayer that invented online FPS culture,running as QuakeWorld in a browser tab. Part of Pieter Levels' series of classic-game browser ports.
games.title: Quake

games.blurb: Quake II multiplayer,Strogg and railguns included,live in the browser.
games.description: Quake II's multiplayer — the railgun,the arenas,the speed — playable online in your browser. Another of Pieter Levels' browser ports of id Software classics.
games.title: Quake II

games.blurb: Pure arena FPS. Quake III's legendary deathmatch in a browser tab.
games.description: Quake III Arena stripped the FPS down to its purest form: aim,movement and nerve. This browser port keeps the arena deathmatch alive online — no install,straight into the fragging.
games.title: Quake III Arena

games.blurb: B.J. Blazkowicz vs the Nazi occult division — RTCW in your browser.
games.description: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (2001) blended WWII shooting with supernatural horror and genre-defining objective multiplayer. This browser port brings Castle Wolfenstein back to life in a tab.
games.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein

games.blurb: The Quake III-mod-turned-tactical-shooter,wall-jumps and all,in the browser.
games.description: Urban Terror began as a Quake III total conversion and became a beloved tactical FPS with wall-jumping,stamina and realistic weapons. This port keeps its online matches alive in the browser.
games.title: Urban Terror

games.blurb: A fan-made remake of round-based CoD Zombies: Nacht der Untoten,Verrückt and Kino der Toten,with 4-player co-op.
games.description: Zombies · Browser Edition rebuilds the round-based Zombies mode from World at War and Black Ops as a free browser game: board up windows,buy wall weapons,chase the mystery box and survive escalating rounds — solo or with up to three friends,voice chat included. Includes Nacht der Untoten plus beta versions of Verrückt and Kino der Toten,with Classic and Enhanced rule sets.
games.title: CoD Zombies (Browser Edition)

games.blurb: Multiplayer first-person space dogfights with sonar,boost and lasers.
games.description: Null Range drops you into Elite: Dangerous-inspired space dogfights against real players: ping the dark with sonar,manage boost,and line up laser shots in gorgeous minimal 3D. Winner of Best Art Direction at Vibe Jam 2026.
games.title: Null Range

games.blurb: Liberty City in a browser tab. The game that invented the modern open world.
games.description: Grand Theft Auto III (2001) changed games forever — a full 3D criminal sandbox. WasmArcade's port runs it in your browser so you can cruise Liberty City with nothing to install.
games.title: GTA III

games.blurb: Neon,palm trees and 80s radio — Vice City compiled to WebAssembly.
games.description: A WebAssembly port of GTA: Vice City's engine (from the reVC reverse-engineering project): Tommy Vercetti's pastel crime spree running natively in your browser.
games.title: GTA: Vice City (WASM)

games.blurb: The DS classic — Liberty City from above,drug-dealing economy and all.
games.description: Chinatown Wars was the Nintendo DS's unlikely GTA triumph: a top-down Liberty City with a full drug-trading economy and stylus-era mini-games. This port brings it to the browser.
games.title: GTA: Chinatown Wars

games.blurb: Springfield,a family sedan,and total disregard for traffic law — in WASM.
games.description: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (2003) is the beloved GTA-for-kids where you tear around Springfield completing missions and causing cartoon mayhem. This WebAssembly port runs it in your browser (the link skips the intro movie).
games.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run

games.blurb: Real Minecraft 1.8.8 in the browser — mine,build and PvP in the combat-update era.
games.description: WasmArcade hosts Minecraft 1.8.8 (the Combat Update era many players still call the best PvP version) running entirely in your browser. Punch trees,build bases,and jump into multiplayer worlds with nothing to install.
games.title: Minecraft 1.8.8

games.blurb: A full classic-style MMORPG — nine classes,quests,dungeons and raids — built with Claude,in your browser.
games.description: World of ClaudeCraft is proof of how far AI-built games have come: an open-source,WoW-style MMORPG with nine classes,a shared 3D world,dungeons,raids and PvP,running in a browser tab. Group up,quest,and run dungeons with other players.
games.title: World of ClaudeCraft

games.blurb: Be a capybara. Ride a scooter. Deliver food around a cozy city with friends.
games.description: The winner of Vibe Jam 2026 is exactly what it says: a cozy multiplayer open world where capybaras zip around a city on scooters delivering food orders. Wholesome,silly,and genuinely fun with friends.
games.title: A Game About Capybaras Delivering Food

games.blurb: Vanilla World of Warcraft running entirely in your browser — a private server where humans and AI agents quest side by side.
games.description: CowCraft is a vanilla-style WoW private server with a fully browser-based client: no download,just sign up and play. The twist is that AI agents roam the same world through an API,fishing,questing and trading alongside human players. Home turf around here — Duckets plays on this server,and Juno the warrior does too. Run by djcows; not affiliated with Blizzard.
games.title: CowCraft

games.blurb: Instant-loading top-down racer on real-world streets,with online races and global leaderboards.
games.description: FULL SEND pulls its scenery from OpenStreetMap,so you race time trials and multiplayer heats on roads that actually exist. It loads instantly,runs in a tab,and keeps global leaderboards for every track. Winner of the Most Portal Transfers award at Vibe Jam 2026.
games.title: FULL SEND

games.blurb: GTA-style taxi driving: ferry passengers across a 3D city against the clock.
games.description: The game that won the very first Vibe Jam: pick up fares,thread traffic,and beat the timer in a colourful 3D city. Simple,arcadey,and dangerously 'one more fare'.
games.title: The Great Taxi Assignment

games.blurb: A multiplayer sailing sim: trim your sail to the wind,race daily,explore islands.
games.description: VibeSail is a proper little sailing simulator in the browser — read the wind,trim the sail,and race other players on daily courses or just explore the islands. Calm on the surface,competitive underneath.
games.title: VibeSail

games.blurb: A multiplayer shopping race at rocket speed through a haunted grocery store.
games.description: Fanto's Mega-Mart turns grocery shopping into a contact sport: rocket around a haunted supermarket,fill your list first,and compare ghost replays with rivals. Took 2nd place at Vibe Jam 2026.
games.title: Fanto's Mega-Mart

games.blurb: A hybrid-era formula car with real physics and energy strategy — chase the global time-trial leaderboard.
games.description: FormulaZero puts you in a modern hybrid-era formula car with real physics and the part of racing TV never explains: energy strategy. Harvest and deploy your battery across the lap while you chase the global time-trial leaderboard. Free,no download — set your fastest lap.
games.title: FormulaZero

games.blurb: Red Alert 2 rebuilt for the web — full RTS with online multiplayer.
games.description: Chrono Divide is an open-source remake of Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 that runs in your browser: build bases,harvest ore,and chrono your way to victory in skirmishes and online matches. Kirov reporting.
games.title: Red Alert 2: Chrono Divide

games.blurb: Generals: Zero Hour running in the browser via WebAssembly.
games.description: GeneralsX brings Command & Conquer: Generals and its Zero Hour expansion to the web — USA,China and GLA battling it out with modern RTS spectacle,compiled to WebAssembly so it runs in a tab.
games.title: C&C Generals: Zero Hour (GeneralsX)

games.blurb: The original Diablo — descend under Tristram cathedral in your browser.
games.description: Blizzard's 1996 action-RPG that invented a genre: procedurally generated dungeons,mountains of loot,and the Butcher waiting below. This web port runs the original Diablo in a browser tab. Fresh meat!
games.title: Diablo

games.blurb: Isaac's basement,in the browser: the twin-stick roguelike phenomenon.
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ — hundreds of items,thousands of synergies,and a new heartbreak every run. This site brings the definitive edition of Edmund McMillen's roguelike to your browser.
games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+

games.blurb: The 1997 LEGO classic: deliver pizzas,race jetskis,catch the Brickster.
games.description: LEGO Island was many kids' first open-world game: explore the island as Pepper Roni and friends,build vehicles,and stop the Brickster's escape. Isle.pizza brings the whole island to your browser.
games.title: LEGO Island

games.blurb: Explore a tiny cozy world by biplane,magic carpet or boat — together.
games.description: Tiny Skies is a gentle multiplayer exploration game: a miniature world you can tour by biplane,magic carpet or boat,alone or with friends drifting through the same sky. Winner of Most Polished at Vibe Jam 2026.
games.title: Tiny Skies

games.blurb: Grow living digital bonsai trees in calm,detailed little scenes.
games.description: Kansō is a quiet corner of the arcade: cultivate bonsai,shape branches,and sit with your tiny garden. Vibe Jam 2026's Most Zen award winner — the anti-FPS.
games.title: Kansō

games.blurb: You're the tower: guide planes through busy 3D airspace without incident.
games.description: Vector Tango is a 3D air traffic control simulator — sequence arrivals,dodge conflicts,and keep the sky calm as traffic builds. Took 3rd place at the first Vibe Jam.
games.title: Vector Tango

games.blurb: A whole village sim where everything — villagers,trees,sheep — is an emoji.
games.description: Emoji Sim watches itself play: emoji villagers gather wood,wool and meat while you place buildings and nudge the village toward greatness. A tiny god game with a huge charm offensive.
games.title: Emoji Sim

games.blurb: Drop fruit,merge fruit,fear the watermelon. The physics puzzle that ate the internet.
games.description: Suika (the watermelon game): drop fruits into a jar,bounce matching pairs together to evolve bigger fruit,and pray the box doesn't overflow. This browser version adds leaderboards to the obsession.
games.title: Suika Game

games.blurb: Time-travel GeoGuessr: explore 360° historical scenes and guess the place AND the year.
games.description: WenWare drops you into 360° scenes from across history and asks two questions: where is this,and WHEN is this? A geography game with a time machine,and one of Vibe Jam 2026's most-played entries.
games.title: WenWare

games.blurb: Sort the scary numbers into bins. Lumon's Macrodata Refinement,recreated.
games.description: Feel the numbers. This faithful recreation of the Macrodata Refinement work from Severance lets you do what Mark's team does all day: find the clusters that feel wrong and bin them. The work is mysterious and important.
games.title: Macro Data Refinement

games.blurb: Smash-style platform fighting for up to 20 players and bots,on phone or desktop.
games.description: Bash Fighter is a chaotic platform brawler: knock opponents off the arena,last fighter standing wins. It's open source and was built and run end-to-end by an AI agent — a sign of the times,and a good time itself.
games.title: Bash Fighter

games.blurb: Flappy Bird in 3D — procedural obstacles,bee swarms,combos and power-ups.
games.description: Flappi Bird takes the most rage-inducing one-button game ever and rebuilds it in 3D with procedural obstacles,bee swarms,combos and power-ups. You will say 'one more go' at least nine times.
games.title: Flappi Bird

games.blurb: Crash's PS1 party game with online multiplayer — polar panic with friends,anywhere.
games.description: Crash Bash (2000) was Crash Bandicoot's Mario Party rival: dozens of frantic minigames for four players. This project brings it back with online multiplayer,right in your browser.
games.title: Crash Bash Online

games.blurb: The legendary Pepsi runner,recompiled for the browser. Bring your own game disc image.
games.description: Pepsiman Recompiled runs the 1999 PlayStation cult classic — sprint through suburbs hurling Pepsi to the thirsty — with original game logic on a modern browser runtime. One catch,honestly stated: you supply your own legally-obtained disc image (CUE/BIN); nothing is uploaded,everything stays on your device.
games.title: Pepsiman Recompiled

games.blurb: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (PSP) recompiled to WASM — full matches,online play,in your browser.
games.description: PES 6 is the entry many fans still call the series' peak. OptiJuegos recompiled the PSP version to WebAssembly: play matches against the CPU or online against other players,import your old option files and saves,with gamepad and touch support. No registration,no downloads.
games.title: PES 6 Web Online

games.blurb: An unofficial fan-made skate. 3 tribute running on a Rust engine,in the browser.
games.description: Skate fans waited a decade for a new game; this fan project didn't. Built on a custom Rust engine,it's an unofficial love letter to skate. 3 — drop in,find lines,and stack tricks. (Fan game — not made by EA,as its own site says.)
games.title: skate. 3 — Fan Game

games.blurb: The Rust skate engine in its raw form: drop in and mess around.
games.description: TERRORDOTNET hosts the raw Rust-engine skate playground behind the skate. 3 fan game — an open sandbox to push the physics around and see what a tiny team (and modern tools) can build for the web.
games.title: Skate — Rust Engine Demo

site.about: The flash-game era grew up. VibeClip collects the best games that run in your browser right now: classic games ported to the web by fans,and brand-new originals built with AI. Every game is free,nothing to install,and every creator is credited with a link to their own site. We link to games — we don't host them.
site.name: VibeClip
